name: Time Out Market
description: Buzzing food hall gathering Lisbon's best chefs under one roof. Go hungry and graze.

name: Cervejaria Ramiro
description: Legendary seafood institution. Order the garlic prawns and a prego to finish.

name: Pasteis de Belem
description: The original 1837 custard tart, still warm and dusted with cinnamon.

name: Jeronimos Monastery
description: UNESCO Manueline masterpiece with breathtaking cloisters in Belem.

name: Belem Tower
description: 16th-century riverfront fortress, the symbolic gateway to old Lisbon.

name: Sao Jorge Castle
description: Moorish hilltop castle with sweeping views over the rooftops and the Tagus.

name: Miradouro Senhora do Monte
description: The highest viewpoint in the city - locals come here for golden hour.

name: LX Factory
description: Converted industrial complex packed with indie shops, murals and cafes.

name: Feira da Ladra
description: Centuries-old flea market - tiles, vinyl and curios every Tue and Sat.

name: Oceanario de Lisboa
description: One of the world's great aquariums, built around a vast central ocean tank.

name: Eduardo VII Park
description: Manicured hillside park with a clean axial view straight down to the river.

name: Jardim da Estrela
description: Romantic 19th-century garden with duck ponds, a bandstand and shady benches.
